{{Quote|Excellent. And you know precisely where in the Unknown Regions Outbound Flight will be stopping?''"<br />"''Yes, my lord. Captain Pakmillu has two separate navigational checks planned for the first eight hundred light-years beyond Republic space. I have the coordinates of both.''"<br />"''Be sure you take the first one. It may be that C'baoth in his impatience will order the second to be canceled.|Darth Sidious and Kinman Doriana|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
An [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] '''star system''' with a [[Star/Legends|sun]] was situated 230 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from the border of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the star system was scheduled to be the first stop in the Unknown Regions for a routine [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] check during the journey undertaken by the Galactic Republic [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colony ship/Legends|colonization vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Thrawn|They will come. The only question is whether or not this system is indeed on the correct straight-line path between their last Republic stop and the system where you were preparing to ambush them.|Kav|Do you dare&mdash;?|Doriana|The vector was calculated correctly. ''Our'' question, on the other hand, is why you think they'll actually stop here.|attr=Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo, Vicelord Siv Kav and Kinman Doriana|src=<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date" /> the star system was the site of the [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|destruction]] of [[Special Task Force One]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After the battle, [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] was ordered to return to the [[Crustai asteroid base]] to meet the returning [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. She dispatched him on a security sweep of nearby [[Star system/Legends|systems]] while she and her [[Ar'alani's inspection group|inspection group]], which included [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], core name "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] and their reluctant guide, [[Jorj Car'das]], conducted an apparent investigation into his latest act of aggression.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Prior to the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|battle of ''Outbound Flight'']], Thrawn took his forces to another [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (red sun)|star system]] and wanted to confirm that it was indeed located on a straight-line path between the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]'s [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system]] and the former Trade Federation battle zone, much to the irritation of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Vicelord]] [[Siv Kav]]. [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] assured Thrawn that the vector was calculated correctly.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
